package.description: Verification substrate for AI coding agents

en-US.description: Verification substrate for AI coding agents
en-US.longDescription: Cairn is a small Go binary that gives AI coding agents durable memory, append-only verdicts, content-addressed evidence, and safe concurrency — the primitives they need to actually finish work without having every claim re-checked. It composes with Superpowers (or any methodology layer) to give agent work a verdict-backed audit trail.
en-US.name: cairn
